mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_alarm WHERE DATE(alarm_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_alarm WHERE is_handled = 0
SELECT DATE(alarm_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM sys_alarm WHERE alarm_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(alarm_time) ORDER BY date
SELECT alarm_type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM sys_alarm WHERE alarm_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY alarm_type

SELECT a.id, a.alarm_type AS type, a.alarm_time AS time, a.confidence, a.is_handled, a.img_path AS imgPath, d.device_name AS deviceName, a.location FROM sys_alarm a LEFT JOIN sys_device d ON d.device_id = a.device_id ORDER BY a.alarm_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
